name: SOSL Search (Object Search)
description: Executes a [Salesforce Object Search Language (SOSL)](https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/atlas.en-us.soql_sosl.meta/soql_sosl/sforce_api_calls_sosl_examples.htm) text-based search query.

configurable_props.name: docsInfo
configurable_props.content: You can find helpful information on SOQL and SOSL in [the Salesforce documentation](https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/atlas.en-us.soql_sosl.meta/soql_sosl/sforce_api_calls_soql_sosl_intro.htm).

configurable_props.name: exampleInfo
configurable_props.content: Example search: `FIND {Joe Smith} IN Name Fields RETURNING lead(name, phone)`

configurable_props.name: search
configurable_props.label: SOSL Query
configurable_props.description: A SOSL search query. [See the documentation](https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/atlas.en-us.soql_sosl.meta/soql_sosl/sforce_api_calls_sosl_examples.htm) for examples and more information.
